# Custom TensorFlow.js Modules

The UMD bundle (`dist/umd/shevchenko.min.js`) uses the modules in this directory instead of the TensorFlow.js backend packages, which keeps the bundle small. `rollup.config.js` swaps them in with aliases. The CommonJS and ES module builds use the regular npm packages.

| File                           | Replaces                         | Contents                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `custom_tfjs_backend_cpu.js`   | `@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-cpu`   | The CPU backend with only the kernels the family name classifier uses. Generated by `build.ts`. |
| `custom_tfjs_backend_webgl.js` | `@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl` | Nothing. The UMD bundle runs on the CPU backend only.                                           |

Background: [Generating size-optimized browser bundles with TensorFlow.js](https://www.tensorflow.org/js/tutorials/deployment/size_optimized_bundles)

## Update the CPU kernels

Run the following command from the repository root after changing the family name classifier model or the way it runs.

```
npx ts-node ./vendor/tfjs/build.ts
```

The script runs the classifier on the CPU backend and regenerates `custom_tfjs_backend_cpu.js` with the kernels it uses. Rebuild the library and run the tests afterwards to check the UMD bundle.

```
npm run build && npm test
```
